IMAX and Films at the Bullock

The Bullock Museum IMAX Theatre provides a one-of-a-kind experience, with cutting-edge dual Laser technology and a screen the size of Texas. The Texas Spirit Theater provides a truly unique experience with three screens and immersive effects.
